title: GaussianWorld: Gaussian World Model for Streaming 3D Occupancy Prediction

output_modality.value: 3D semantic occupancy for the current frame, framed as 4D occupancy forecasting in a 3D Gaussian space

control_signal.value: No user control. Model inputs are the current multi-camera RGB images, historical 3D Gaussians and the ego pose or trajectory used for alignment

control_mechanism.value: Historical Gaussians are aligned by ego motion, new areas completed with random Gaussians, then refined by an evolution layer with sparse convolution and deformable attention to image features

base_model.value: Gaussian scene representation following GaussianFormer; FPN multi-scale image features; 25600 Gaussians and 4 Gaussian world layers; two-stage training, streaming training last

datasets.value: nuScenes (700/150/150 train/val/test scenes), occupancy labels from SurroundOcc

metrics.value: IoU and mIoU for semantic occupancy, plus inference latency and memory

controllability_evidence.value: not applicable, no control input. Prediction gain: mIoU +2.4% and IoU +2.7% over single-frame GaussianFormer-B; ablations on ego motion and dynamic-object factors

closed_loop.value: no; streaming perception on recorded sequences, not rolled out with a driving policy

stated_limitations.value: Cannot reach full cross-frame consistency for static scenes, due to inaccurate separation of dynamic and static elements

notes: Not a generator with a control input: a world-model-based perception model for occupancy prediction. Latency 228 ms versus 225 ms single-frame (Table 2).
